_comment: Per-screen ad config. Paste this whole object as the VALUE of the Firebase Remote Config parameter 'ads_screen_config'. The app only reads the 'screens' object; keys starting with '_' are docs and ignored. NATIVE gating: global 'ads_enabled' AND a screen's 'enabled' (format 1-4 use the screen's native unit; format 0 uses the global banner). INTERSTITIAL gating: global 'ads_enabled' AND 'ads_interstitial_enabled' AND a screen's 'interstitial'. 'int_freq' sets the per-screen interstitial cadence: N>1 = show on the 1st action and every Nth after; 0 or 1 = show every time; -1 = disable the interstitial on that screen (never loads).

_formats.3: small native, app icon left full width CTA
_formats.4: medium native with media (~220dp, large_ media view style)

_interstitial: Per-screen interstitial switch, mirroring the native 'enabled' toggle, with 'int_freq' for cadence (N>1 every Nth, 0/1 every time, -1 disabled). An interstitial only shows where a trigger is wired: 'home' (every home menu navigation, int_freq 0), 'editor' (every save, int_freq 0), 'calculator' (every calculator card tap, int_freq 0), 'language' (Done → onboarding, int_freq 0), 'splash' (splash screen), 'premium' (paywall/IAP close button — shows on every close; set 'interstitial': false or 'int_freq': -1 to disable). Setting 'interstitial': true on a screen with no trigger has no effect yet.
